description: This file contains a static class 'VisualTree' with extension methods for navigating the visual tree in a UWP application, including methods to find descendant and ascendant controls by name or type.

classes.name: VisualTree
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for traversing the visual tree in a UWP app.

methods.name: FindDescendantByName
methods.description: Finds a descendant FrameworkElement by name within the visual tree starting from a given element.

methods.name: FindDescendant
methods.description: Recursively searches for a descendant of a specific type within the visual tree.

methods.name: FindAscendantByName
methods.description: Finds an ascendant FrameworkElement by name starting from a given element.

methods.name: FindAscendant
methods.description: Recursively searches for an ascendant of a specific type within the visual tree.
